import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0031.png')
# Floor lamp base disc in obs 31:
# Let's crop around the base disc: u in [240, 290], v in [330, 370]
crop = img[330:370, 240:290]
# The floor lamp base disc has a non-floor color.
floor = img[450, 300]
disc = np.linalg.norm(crop.astype(float) - floor.astype(float), axis=2) > 20
vs, us = np.where(disc)
print(f'Disc u range: {240 + us.min()} to {240 + us.max()}, center u = {240 + us.mean():.1f}')
print(f'Disc v range: {330 + vs.min()} to {330 + vs.max()}, lowest v = {330 + vs.max()}')

# Plant pot base in obs 31:
crop_plant = img[320:380, 400:460]
disc_plant = np.linalg.norm(crop_plant.astype(float) - floor.astype(float), axis=2) > 20
vs_p, us_p = np.where(disc_plant)
print(f'Plant u range: {400 + us_p.min()} to {400 + us_p.max()}, center u = {400 + us_p.mean():.1f}')
print(f'Plant v range: {320 + vs_p.min()} to {320 + vs_p.max()}, lowest v = {320 + vs_p.max()}')
"
